name: Neversong & Pinstripe
summary:
Neversong – A dark, side-scrolling action-adventure about a boy named Peet who awakens from a coma to find his girlfriend missing and his town overtaken by strange adults. Blending eerie storytelling with puzzle-platforming, it mixes atmospheric exploration, combat, and emotional themes.

Pinstripe – A gothic adventure-platformer following ex-minister Ted as he journeys through a surreal afterlife to rescue his daughter from the sinister figure Pinstripe. With hand-drawn art, puzzle-solving, and a haunting tone, it’s a story-driven game about loss, love, and redemption.
